name: planning-skills-for-agents-and-humans
description: Planning workflows with evidence-gated Lead User research, fluid collaborative shaping, explicit promotion gates, Wayfinding, breadboarding, executable handoffs, context, and reflection.

interface.longDescription: Reusable planning workflows for product and engineering work. Start from requirements, a proposed solution, evidence, or a focused uncertainty; move through framing, shaping, breadboarding, implementation handoff, drift checking, and reflection as needed; preserve explicit human decisions about direction, appetite, promotion, and scope.
defaultPrompt: Help me shape this product idea without choosing the solution for me.
Figure out the smallest planning move this project needs.
Check whether this implementation has drifted from the accepted plan.
